description: Activate when: user asks why customers don't switch to a better product, how to make a product stickier or build a moat, how to compete against an entrenched incumbent, why churn is low but revenue growth stalled, or mentions lock-in / vendor lock-in / stickiness / data moat / Klemperer. Do NOT activate when: the product is a one-shot transaction with no ongoing relationship, or the user is designing adversarial lock-in and needs ethical pushback first. More: deciqai.com/c/switching-costs

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
